exposure: Women who had delivered at least 1 child vaginally
outcome: changes in vaginal support at the anterior vaginal wall (point Ba)
cohort: 1224 parous women recruited 5-10 years from first delivery
finding: Vaginal birth was associated with worse support 5 years from first delivery and with more rapid deterioration in support at the apex.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was associated with worse support 5 years from first delivery and with more rapid deterioration in support at the apex.
